name: Kiwanis Thrift Shop
addr: 503 W State St, Black Mountain, NC 28711
hours: Mon 10 AM–5 PM; Tue 10 AM–5 PM; Wed 10 AM–5 PM; Thu 10 AM–5 PM; Fri 10 AM–5 PM; Sat 10 AM–5 PM; Sun Closed

reviews.t: more clothing than toys/housewares/etc, the store is very clean and the staff is definitely friendly.
A good variety of thrift items packed neatly in a small shop with the sweetest staff
The volunteers are lovely & the prices are great. May they be blessed!
Many happy, friendly volunteers at the Kiwanis thrift store. If you can't find what you want, return again and it may be there.
Folks are so nice!! Always stop by when I visit Beautiful Black Mountain!! Always surprises at the great prices!!
Great little thrift shop. Had some quality items. Well organized and fairly priced
I absolutely love this place! The pricing is excellent and the staff is super friendly. The store is very clean and organized and they always have amazing stuff. It's one of my favorite places to go!

Thrift stores are wonderful for several reasons, my favorite being that they assist with repurpose and keeping things out of landfills. Just because we tire of an item doesn't mean that there is no value left and that someone else can't use it. This thrift store is well organized, clean, friendly, and constantly restocking and their prices are reasonable. I check by when I am in the area because you never know what treasures await. Thank you Kiwanis Club of Black Mountain for giving back to the community.
